'''Jakka''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] enforcer of the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]]-based [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Subo]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]]. Jakka had many [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic]] implants, making him very difficult to kill.
